name: crowd-comedy
title: Crowd Comedy
description: Players submit punchlines to a shared prompt, then vote on the funniest anonymous answer.
instructions: Answer each prompt, vote for the funniest line, and rack up points across five rounds.

amen.title: Joyful Noise
amen.description: Write the funniest clean punchline to a shared prompt, then vote for the one that brings the most joy.
